churches.assessment: The Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament is the Chevy Chase Roman Catholic parish where Justice Brett Kavanaugh is a member — he attends the 5:30 PM Sunday Mass with his family and has coached girls' basketball at the parish school. Founded 1911, the church is a large, active suburban parish of the Archdiocese of Washington under Pastor Rev. Gary R. Studniewski, with a parochial K-8 school. Theologically, the parish holds the historic Catholic positions: Nicene-Chalcedonian Christology, male-only priesthood, traditional sexual ethics, opposition to abortion. MOOP's rubric is built around Protestant confessional categories — sola Scriptura, justification by faith alone — so Catholic parishes register as yellow with a denominational note, neither green nor red. Within the Roman Catholic tradition, Blessed Sacrament is unremarkable in its orthodoxy and is a serious, traditional Catholic parish.

churches.assessment: Saint Joseph Parish in South Bend is the Roman Catholic parish where Justice Amy Coney Barrett is a longtime member — she served as Council Chair for two one-year terms between 2013 and June 2015, providing counsel to the pastor and assisting in parish duties. Founded 1853, the parish is in the Diocese of Fort Wayne–South Bend and is pastored by the Congregation of Holy Cross (C.S.C.) — the same religious order that runs the University of Notre Dame, where Justice Barrett taught law for years. Current pastor Fr. Matt Fase, C.S.C. The parish operates a robust parochial Pre-K through 8th grade school, a Totus Tuus summer faith program (grades 1-12), and the Catechesis of the Good Shepherd children's formation program. Theologically the parish holds the historic Catholic positions: Nicene Christology, male-only priesthood, sacramental soteriology, traditional sexual ethics. MOOP's rubric is built around Protestant confessional categories, so Catholic parishes register as yellow with a denominational note. Within the Catholic tradition, Saint Joseph South Bend is a serious, orthodox parish tied to the Holy Cross + Notre Dame tradition.

Its location has long attracted members of Congress, congressional staffers, and Supreme Court justices to daily Mass — historical attendees documented include Senators John E. Kenna, Robert F. Kennedy, Ted Kennedy, and Justice Antonin Scalia. Current pastor Rev. William H. Gurnee III. Founded 1868. Per MOOP Protestant frame this is YELLOW — Catholic sacramental soteriology and Magisterium-Scripture-Tradition triad fall outside sola fide / sola scriptura, but the parish carries no particular doctrinal anomalies within Catholic standards. Included for situational awareness about a key DC Catholic parish serving the legislative + judicial branches.

churches.assessment: St. Patrick's Catholic Church at 619 10th Street NW is the oldest Catholic parish in the federal city of Washington, D.C., founded 1794 by Fr. Anthony Caffry to minister to the Irish stonemasons building the White House and the U.S. Capitol. Current pastor Rev. Patrick S. Lewis. Located in downtown DC, the parish has served the federal workforce and visiting dignitaries continuously since the federal government moved to Washington. Per MOOP Protestant frame this is YELLOW — Catholic sacramental soteriology and Magisterium-Scripture-Tradition triad fall outside sola fide / sola scriptura, but the parish is doctrinally unremarkable within Catholic standards. Included as a historically significant DC Catholic landmark. Note: contrary to the original directory R26 brief, Joe Biden's DC Catholic parish during his presidency was Holy Trinity (Georgetown), not St. Patrick — Holy Trinity has been added separately to this batch.
